counter_limits: Canonical FP16 logical products and actual BF16 operands differ; scalar lower bound excludes weight zeros and probability underflow. Physical MMA counts include attention causal padding and twofold h/z row padding. MMA bypass includes SIMT substitution; SIMT counts are separate. Sparse-path ablation shares paired normalization fusion; unfused K049 isolates fusion. Counts do not measure runtime or memory traffic.
uncertainty: Points are geometric means of paired ratios, equally weighted across three processes; bars are min-max of process geometric means, not confidence intervals or training-seed uncertainty.
